notes.title: Version 1.01 is out!
notes.notes:
Hello, dear acolytes.

It is I, The Storyteller, here to bring you some good news:

Thanks to the feedback I've gotten from players and content creators, I was able to track down a few bugs and fix them. Additionally, I added a few minor tweaks to make a certain puzzle more straightforward. Your experience with my session will now be smoother than ever before!

Thanks to everyone for their patience. I hope you will continue to have fun with Fremdganger - The Cheating Demon!
